class.name: PHASEOccluder3D
class.brief_description: Blocks and filters audio using mesh geometry in the PHASE engine.
class.description: Uses a referenced [MeshInstance3D]'s geometry to create an acoustic occlusion shape in the PHASE engine. Audio passing through the occluder is attenuated and filtered based on the selected [member material] preset. Set [member mesh_node_path] to point at a [MeshInstance3D] in the scene. The mesh's vertices and edges are sent to PHASE to define the occlusion shape. The occluder's transform is synced to PHASE each physics frame.

members.member: The acoustic material preset for this occluder. Determines how sound is attenuated and filtered when passing through. These are the material presets provided by Apple's PHASE framework.
Path to a [MeshInstance3D] node whose geometry defines the occlusion shape. Changing this path recreates the occluder in the PHASE engine.
